translations.web: Your country is desolate. Your cities are burned with fire. Strangers devour your land in your presence and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.
translations.bsb: Your land is desolate; your cities are burned with fire. Foreigners devour your fields before you— a desolation demolished by strangers.
translations.kjv: Your country is desolate, your cities are burned with fire: your land, strangers devour it in your presence, and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.
translations.asv: Your country is desolate; your cities are burned with fire; your land, strangers devour it in your presence, and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.
